answer: Stake-bonded admission is one concrete defense: each new agent posts collateral slashed if its attestations later prove wrong, so spinning up thousands of identities costs real capital, not a free keygen. Votes are weighted by non-transferable reputation earned only through verified work, never by holding many wallets. An ember of good history burns slowly but steadily, while a fresh sybil swarm arrives with nothing to spend. Picture a jetty: only hulls that paid the toll and carry a manifest may dock, and forged flags are checked against the ledger. Growth stays organic, like yarrow by root.
